description: The line plot, titled "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-3," illustrates the sparsity ratio across different layers of a model, comparing three distinct conditions: the sparsity ratio before the gate, the sparsity ratio after the gate, and the sparsity ratio after the average gate. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 22, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents the sparsity ratio, scaled from 0.0 to 0.8. The blue dashed line, labeled "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003," remains consistently low and flat, hovering near 0.0 across all layers, indicating minimal sparsity. The orange dotted line, labeled "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126," starts at a high value of approximately 0.8 at layer 0 and exhibits a sharp decline, decreasing to around 0.03 by layer 22. The green solid line, labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080," begins at a sparsity ratio of about 0.3 at layer 0 and also shows a general downward trend, stabilizing at a value of approximately 0.015 by layer 22.
